scientific_integrity: The construction and counting identities are proved analytically; finite exhaustive checks are corroboration and not infinite certification. Priority over unindexed work remains uncertain. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Identical nonnegative unit-additive values only; complete multipartite conflict graphs. Labeled agents and goods. The scarcity law is under uniform sampling of maximal feasible allocations, not a dynamic procedure. Classical complete equitable-coloring obstructions are not new.
title: Maximal EF1 on complete multipartite conflicts: existence, exact counts, and a parity bottleneck
